label: Slabs and covered length
subgoals: Cut the plane into slabs at distinct x-coordinates
Find the covered y-length in each slab
Sum width times covered length over the slabs

label: Maintaining the covered length
subgoals: List the y-ranges of the rectangles active at the stop
Sum the merged lengths to get the covered length

label: Area covered at least twice
subgoals: Keep a cover count for each y-interval in the slab
Sum the lengths where the count reaches two
Accumulate width times that length over the slabs
